Promotion Details

New betPARX users can sign up and create an account. Once registered, they will receive:

100% Bet Insurance up to $50 on their first eligible sports bet. If their first eligible sports bet loses, they will get their bet amount back as a Bonus Bet. Users must deposit at least ten dollars ($10) and place the bet with cash.

Real cash funds must be used for qualifying sports wagers to earn the Bonus Bet (from Bet Insurance).

Refer to the ‘Wagering Requirements and Limitations’ section below for qualifying bet information.

Bonus Bet the users earn from the 100% Bet Insurance offer will be eligible for any sport. Bonus Bet will expire seven (7) days after issuance. Bonus Bet is available for any sport.

Wagering Requirements and Limitations

First Sports Wager to Qualify for Bet Insurance

  • Eligible Bets: Pre-match singles, parlays, same game parlays (SGPs), multigame parlays and live bets with minimum odds of -200 or greater. Real funds (cash) must be used.
  • Ineligible Bets: Daily boosts, profit boosts, round robins, teasers and bets settled via cashout.

For Bonus Bets Awarded

  • Bonus Bet may only be used once and may not be divided into multiple bets.
  • Bonus Bet amount is non-withdrawable and is not included in any returns or winnings.
  • Bonus Bet may be used on any sport.
  • Bonus Bet only may be used for online sports wagering.
